meals.name: Breakfast
suggestions: 2 Whole Boiled Eggs + 1 bowl of Sprout/Chaat / Veggies.
150g Milkmist Plain Greek Yogurt mixed with seeds or a handful of sprouts.

meals.name: Lunch
suggestions: 100g to 150g Cooked White/Brown Rice (or 2 small Chapathis) + 80g Paneer / 100g Chicken breast curry (cooked with minimal oil) + 1 bowl Veggies/Dal.
150g Rice + Generous portion of Soya Chunks (~40g dry weight) + Veggie curry.

meals.name: Evening Snack
suggestions: Black Coffee / Green Tea + a small handful of almonds/walnuts.

meals.name: Dinner
suggestions: 2 Small Chapathis (or 100g Idli/Dosa batter cooked into thin dosas) + 60–80g Grilled/Curry Chicken or Soya Chunks + Veggies.
1 bowl of leafy green dal + 1 cup low-fat curd + 1 small Chapathi or light rice portion.
